name: macos-nested-resource-signing
description: Sign real upstream uv, Node, Sharp, and libvips Mach-O resources before Tauri bundling.
given: Pinned darwin-arm64 runtime archives, an installed Developer ID Application identity, and the macOS resource-signing script
when: The signing script scans the staged resource tree with an explicit keychain
then: Every Mach-O resource has the 2389 Developer ID authority, a secure timestamp, hardened runtime, and a strict valid signature while plain executable data remains unsigned
